resources.string: Android protects other apps' data. You can clear this app's cache here. To clear another app's cache, go to Android Settings > Apps > [app] > Storage and use its Clear cache control. Labels may vary by device.

Cache Cleaner does not collect, transmit, or share personal data. It has no account, advertising, analytics, tracking, third-party SDKs, or internet permission.\n\nCache size checks and cache deletion happen locally on the device and are limited to Cache Cleaner's own app-specific cache directories. The app does not access or clear other apps' data. It does not store or transmit the displayed cache size, usage information, or diagnostics.
